topic: How a small hair salon can fill empty weekday slots
title: Fill salon weekday slots fast
title_options: How to pack weekday salon bookings
description:
Quick, low-cost marketing to book slow weekday hours. This short shows one simple offer you can run today.
Use the exact words and steps here to set up a weekday express service, target local workers, and track bookings with minimal effort.

scenes.narration: Want weekday clients at your salon?
Create a Weekday Express: a 30-minute refresh at a reduced price for office workers nearby.
Offer 'Weekday Express: 30-minute blowout or trim, $25, Tue–Thu 10am–2pm' — clear and specific.
Post the offer on your page, pin a post, and share a short reel showing the quick service.
Text previous clients and message nearby offices: 'Quick mid-day refresh? Walk-ins welcome, or book by text.'
Track which days fill, keep the price for a month, tweak hours if needed. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
